PE: Did s/he place the stethoscope on the skin?
ICS: Strongly Agree: The student doctor made a personal connection. (Warm, interested in me as a person, greeted me by name. The connection felt genuine.)
Agree: The student doctor attempted to make a personal connection. (Made some effort to get to know me as a person, but I didn’t feel s/he was genuine.)
Disagree: The student doctor did not attempt to make a personal connection. (Made no effort to know me as a person. Gave me the impression she was only interested in me as a disease or a symptom.)

Strongly Agree: I was favorably impressed by the student doctor's effective use of this behavior. (Invited me to speak. Encouraged me to tell my story. Asked open-ended questions. Did not interrupt me.)
Agree: I observed the student doctor using this behavior. (Gave me an opportunity to speak without interruption.)
Disagree: I did not observe the student doctor using this behavior. (I just answered the questions asked; student used closed-ended questions only.)

Strongly Agree: I was favorably impressed by the student doctor's effective use of this behavior. (Used body language that was open and encouraging - appropriate eye contact, body position. Use of silence facilitated communication.)
Agree: I observed the student doctor using this behavior. (Didn’t rush me. Comfortable eye contact.)

Disagree: I did not observe the student doctor using this behavior. (Asked same question several times. Nervousness interfered with ability to focus on me. Long pauses made me feel uncomfortable. Positioned too close or too far away. Used closed body language. Focused solely on clipboard or notes.)

Strongly Agree: I was favorably impressed by the student doctor's effective use of this behavior. (Followed up on my answers, summarized and allowed me to clarify; I was sure the student understood my story.)
Agree: I observed the student doctor using this behavior. (Followed up or clarified some of my answers.)
Disagree: I did not observe the student doctor using this behavior. (Never verified what I was saying.)
Strongly Agree: I was favorably impressed by the student doctor's effective use of this behavior. (Asked if I had questions as the encounter progressed.)
Agree: I observed the student doctor using this behavior. (Asked me if I had any questions only at the end of the encounter.)
Disagree: I did not observe the student doctor using this behavior. (Didn’t ask me if I had any questions or if I understood him/her.)

Strongly Agree: I was favorably impressed by the student doctor's effective use of this behavior. (Spoke clearly in a way I could understand without talking down to me. All explanations and questions were clear.)
Agree: I observed the student doctor using this behavior. (Used a little jargon but explained without prompting.)
Disagree: I did not observe the student doctor using this behavior. (Some jargon, explained with prompting; explanations were vague.)
Strongly Agree: The student doctor VERBALLY expressed empathy in a genuine manner. (Found out my concerns, offered comments to validate my feelings and concerns.)

Agree: The student doctor VERBALLY expressed empathy BUT it did NOT feel genuine (said the "right words: without exhibiting genuine warmth/sincerity). (Heard my concerns, sounded a bit empathetic, didn’t validate my concerns.)
Disagree: The student doctor did not verbally express empathy. (Glossed over symptoms or concerns that should have elicited empathy.)

Strongly Agree: I was favorably impressed by the student doctor’s effective use of this behavior. (Treated me with respect at all times. Recognized by discomfort and helped me to feel more comfortable.)
Agree: I observed the student doctor using this behavior. (Was mostly respectfully with tone of voice. I felt my problems were taken seriously by the student.)
Disagree: I did not observe the student doctor using this behavior. (I felt ignored, or that the student’s agenda was more important than me, or that my problems were not important.)
Strongly Agree: I was favorably impressed by the student doctor’s effective use of this behavior. (Negotiated with me on the feasibility of the plan.)
Agree: I observed the student doctor using this behavior. (Presented a plan and asked me if it was okay).

Disagree: I did not observe the student doctor using this behavior. (Did not involve me in making the plan and did not check with me. Made it clear that I had to do things in the way s/he suggested and my opinion about it did not matter.)
Strongly Agree: I was favorably impressed by the student doctor's effective use of this behavior. (Specifically asked if I had any concerns about the plan AND addressed them.)
Agree: I observed the student doctor using this behavior. (Asked if I have any concerns about the plan but did not directly address them.)
Disagree: I did not observe the student doctor using this behavior. (Did not ask if I have any concerns about the plan.)
